subject: DI03000101

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose voltage through constrained life-cycle comparison,not the rule that the highest voltage is always best.

Explanation and application

  • For three-phase real power P=√3VLLIcosφ,higher Vat fixed P/pfreduces I;for unchanged R,loss3I²Rfalls approximately as1/V².
  • Higher voltage raises insulation,clearance,switchgear,transformer and sometimes corridor cost;lower voltage may require larger conductors and produce greater loss/drop.
  • Compare annualised capital,energy losses,reliability,load growth and standard available voltages;include reactive compensation and system constraints.No universal economic voltage is assigned without project data.
Kelvin law balances all capital?

No;only the area-dependent annual capital component equals loss cost under the model.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Constrained life-cycle comparisonથી V પસંદ કરો.Highest V હંમેશાં best નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • P=√3VLLIcosφમાં fixed P-pfએ V વધતાં I ઘટે.Same Rમાં loss3I²R લગભગ1/V² મુજબ ઘટે.
  • Higher Vથી insulation,clearance,switchgear,transformer/corridor cost વધી શકે.Lower Vમાં larger conductor/loss-drop વધી શકે.
  • Annualised capital,energy loss,reliability,growth/available standard V compare કરો.Compensation/system constraints લો.Data વિના universal economic V નઆપો.
Kelvin Law All Capital Balance કરે?

નહિ.Modelમાં area-dependent annual capital/loss cost સમાન થાય.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Let annual area-dependent capital cost=bAand annual loss cost=c/Afor constant material/length and a specified load-duration/price model;other cost Fis constant.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Total annual cost C(A)=F+bA+c/A,where A>0.
  2. Differentiate:dC/dA=b−c/A².Set zero at the unconstrained minimum.
  3. Aopt=√(c/b).At this area bAopt=c/Aopt:annual area-dependent capital equals annual loss cost.
  4. d²C/dA²=2c/A³>0confirms a minimum for b,c>0.

Interpretation and check

This is not equality with ALLcapital cost.Select the available size that satisfies thermal,voltage-drop,strength,short-circuit,corona and growth requirements.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Area-dependent annual capital bA/loss c/A લો.Material-length/load-duration-price model specified છે.Other cost F constant છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Annual cost C(A)=F+bA+c/A છે,A>0 લો.
  2. dC/dA=b−c/A² છે.Unconstrained minimum માટે zero લો.
  3. Aopt=√(c/b) છે.ત્યાં bAopt=c/Aopt એટલે area-dependent capital/loss cost સમાન છે.
  4. b,c>0માં d²C/dA²=2c/A³>0 હોવાથી minimum છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ ALL capital costની equality નથી.Thermal,drop,strength,SC,corona/growth limits સંતોષતો available size લો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative b=200₹/(mm²·year),c=80000₹·mm²/year;Fignored for the optimum only.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Aopt=√(80000/200)=20mm².
  2. Area-dependent capital=200×20=4000₹/year;loss cost=80000/20=4000₹/year.
  3. Variable annual cost8000₹/year;actual commercial selection still requires all non-economic checks and available conductor sizes.

Interpretation and check

Loss cost depends on annual I²integral,energy tariff and resistance/temperature;unknown future load or nonlinear capital assumptions limit the law.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Illustrative b=200₹/(mm²·year),c=80000₹·mm²/year લો.Optimum માટે જ F ignore કરો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Aopt=√(80000/200)=20mm² છે.
  2. Area-dependent capital200×20=4000₹/year અને loss80000/20=4000₹/year છે.
  3. Variable cost8000₹/year છે.Actual sizeમાં તમામ other checks/available sizes જરૂરી છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Loss cost annual I² integral,tariff/R-T પર આધારિત છે.Future load/nonlinear capitalથી lawની limits આવે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

EHVACcarries large power at high voltage within a synchronous network.

Explanation and application

  • Advantages:lower current for a given power,bulk transfer,easier ACvoltage transformation and integration with existing synchronous substations/intermediate taps.
  • Limits include reactive charging,voltage control,stability limits,corona,large insulation/clearance and fault-level/protection needs;long cables can be charging-limited.
  • Using line-line voltage magnitudes Vs/Vrand per-phase X,the ideal lossless relation P≈VsVr sinδ/Xshows dependence on voltage,angle and reactance,but is not a complete thermal/stability rating.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

EHV AC high Vએ synchronous networkમાં large P વહન કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Same Pમાં ઓછો I,bulk transfer,easy AC transformation/existing substations-intermediate taps સાથે integration મળે.
  • Reactive charging,V control,stability,corona,insulation-clearance/fault-protection limits છે.Long cable chargingથી limit થઈ શકે.
  • Line-line Vs/Vr magnitudes અને per-phase Xમાં ideal lossless P≈VsVr sinδ/Xથી V,angle/reactance dependence સમજાય;તે complete thermal-stability rating નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Compare complete terminal-plus-corridor costs for the same transfer duty and reliability.

Explanation and application

  • HVDCcan be attractive for long high-power routes,long submarine/underground cables and asynchronous interconnection;expensive converter terminals can be offset by line/cable benefits.
  • ACcan suit shorter routes,multiple taps and synchronous networks where transformers and conventional substations are economical;DCtapping requires converter infrastructure.
  • Break-even distance is project-dependent,not a universal600kmor other fixed number;land,cable share,capacity,technology,loss,financing and security change it.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Same transfer/reliability માટે terminal+corridor total cost compare કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Long high-P route,cables/asynchronous interconnectionમાં HVDC યોગ્ય હોઈ શકે.Converter cost સામે line-cable benefits મળે.
  • Shorter routes,multiple taps/synchronous networksમાં AC economical હોઈ શકે.DC tap માટે converter જોઈએ.
  • Break-even distance project-dependent છે;universal600km કે fixed number નથી.Land,cable,capacity,technology,loss,finance/securityથી બદલાય.

body.en:
Definition

Converter stations connect ACsystems through a controlled DCpath.

Classification / representative type

  • LCCuses line-commutated thyristors;VSCuses self-commutated converter valves.Station equipment depends on this technology.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. ACswitchyard and converter transformers connect the ACnetwork and provide suitable voltage/insulation.
  2. Valve halls,semiconductor assemblies,insulation and cooling perform controlled conversion.
  3. DCreactors,DCbus/line or cable and protection arrangements control ripple/transients and connect terminals.
  4. Filters and reactive support are technology/system-specific:LCCtypically requires substantial reactive support and harmonic filtering.
  5. Digital controls,measurements,telecommunications and protection coordinate current,voltage and power order.
  6. Electrode/metallic return,earthing and auxiliary systems follow the authorised topology and environmental design.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Sending ACis transformed and converted to controlled DC.
  2. The DCcircuit carries power with current set by the converter control.
  3. Receiving conversion delivers ACpower to the connected grid.
  4. LCCcommutation needs the ACsystem;VSCcan control voltage/reactive exchange more independently within its current/energy limits.
  5. Controls coordinate ramps,power reversal and disturbances;the exact current/polarity reversal mechanism depends on converter technology.
  6. Protection,cooling and auxiliaries maintain safe operation;DCfaults need specialised detection and interruption arrangements.

Limitations and safety

This is a functional station overview,not a valve firing,earth-electrode or HVconstruction procedure.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Converter stations ACsystemsને controlled DCpathથી જોડે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • LCCમાં line-commutated thyristors/VSCમાં self-commutated valves હોય.Equipment technology મુજબ બદલાય.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. ACswitchyard/converter transformer network connection/V-insulation આપે.
  2. Valve hall,semiconductor assembly,insulation/cooling conversion કરે.
  3. DCreactor,bus,line-cable/protection ripple-transients control/terminal connection કરે.
  4. Filters/reactive support technology-specific છે.LCCમાં સામાન્ય રીતે significant support/filtering જોઈએ.
  5. Controls,measurements,communication/protection I-V/power order coordinate કરે.
  6. Electrode-metallic return,earthing/auxiliaries authorised topology/environment design પ્રમાણે હોય.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Sending AC transform થઈ controlled DC બને.
  2. DCcircuit converter control પ્રમાણે I સાથે P વહન કરે.
  3. Receiving conversion connected gridને ACpower આપે.
  4. LCC commutation માટે ACsystem જોઈએ.VSC current-energy limitsમાં V-reactive exchange વધુ independently control કરે.
  5. Controls ramps,reversal/disturbance coordinate કરે.Current-polarity reversal technology પ્રમાણે બદલાય.
  6. Protection,cooling/auxiliaries safe operation જાળવે.DCfault માટે special detection-interruption જોઈએ.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

આ station overview છે;valve firing,electrode/HV construction procedure નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Classify by pole/return arrangement and terminal topology;these are different classification axes.

Explanation and application

  • Monopolar:one high-voltage pole with approved earth/sea or metallic return.Bipolar:positive and negative poles with neutral/return provisions;balanced normal operation can minimise earth current.
  • Homopolar uses multiple same-polarity conductors and a return;it is a historical/less-common arrangement and not the same as a bipolar link.
  • Back-to-back:converters share a short DCconnection to exchange power between ACsystems without a long DCline.Multiterminal:more than two converter terminals,requiring coordinated control/protection.
  • A ±320kVbipole has nominal640kVbetween poles,not320kV;at ideal2000MW,P/(2Vpole)=3125A.No actual operating current is inferred without conditions.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Pole-return arrangement અને terminal topology અલગ classification axes છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Monopolarમાં એક HVpole/approved earth-sea-metallic return હોય.Bipolarમાં +/− poles/neutral-return હોય.Balanced normal operation earth current ઓછી કરી શકે.
  • Homopolarમાં multiple same-polarity conductors/return હોય;આ historical-less-common arrangement છે,bipolar નથી.
  • Back-to-backમાં short DCconnectionથી ACsystems જોડાય,long line નથી.Multiterminalમાં બે કરતાં વધુ terminals/coordination જોઈએ.
  • ±320kVbipoleમાં pole-pole640kV છે,320kV નહીં.Ideal2000MW માટે P/(2Vpole)=3125A છે.Conditions વિના actual I નધારો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

DCadvantages must be balanced against conversion and system-integration requirements.

Explanation and application

  • Merits:controlled bulk transfer,asynchronous ACinterconnection and no continuous ACcapacitive charging current in a DCcable during steady state.DCcables still have capacitance and energisation transients.
  • Demerits:terminal capital,conversion loss,complex control/protection and specialised equipment.LCCneeds commutation strength/reactive support;VSCcapability remains bounded by ratings.
  • Applications:long bulk overhead links,submarine/underground links,asynchronous ties and some renewable integration schemes.Choose technology from the required system duty,not the label alone.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

DCbenefits સાથે conversion/system requirements પણ ગણો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Controlled bulk transfer,asynchronous interconnection/steady DCcableમાં continuous AC charging I નથી;પણ C/energisation transients રહે છે.
  • Terminal cost,conversion loss,complex control-protection/special equipment જોઈએ.LCCને commutation strength/reactive support જોઈએ.VSC પણ rating-limited છે.
  • Long OH,cable links,asynchronous ties/renewable schemesમાં ઉપયોગ થાય.System duty પરથી technology પસંદ કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Match power,distance,corridor and reliability before comparing costs.

Explanation and application

  • HVACnormally needs compatible synchronous operation and carries real/reactive current;HVDCcan decouple ACfrequency/phase while converters still need compatible local ACconnections.
  • ACvoltage conversion/tapping is straightforward with transformers;DCintermediate ACloads need converter stations.DCpower flow is directly controllable;ACflow follows network impedances/angles unless controlled.
  • Neither is always lower-loss or cheaper:compare line,cable,converter/transformer,reactive compensation and availability on a common annual basis.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Cost compare કરતાં પહેલાં power,distance,corridor/reliability સમાન લો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • HVACને synchronous compatibility જોઈએ અને real-reactive I વહે.HVDC ACfrequency-phase decouple કરે;local converter ACconnection યોગ્ય હોવું જોઈએ.
  • ACમાં transformerથી conversion-tapping સરળ છે.DCથી ACload માટે converter જોઈએ.DC flow controlled;AC flow network impedance-angleથી નક્કી થાય.
  • કોઈ system હંમેશાં સસ્તી/lower-loss નથી.Line,cable,terminal,compensation/availability common annual basis પર compare કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Examples illustrate technology and route,not an exhaustive live asset register.

Explanation and application

  • POWERGRIDmilestones record the ±800kVRaigarh–Pugalur link and completion of the6000MWRaigarh–Pugalur–Thrissur mega project in2021;do not confuse a commissioning-stage pole rating with an entire scheme.
  • The2021Pugalur–North Thrissur example uses ±320kVVSCtechnology;documented2000MWtransfer to Kerala illustrates the combined overhead/cable corridor application.
  • For reports record source/date,terminal locations,converter type,pole versus pole-pole voltage,scheme capacity and actual commissioning status;do not label every planned Indian project commissioned.

Reference: [1](https://www.powergrid.in/en/milestones) — POWERGRID milestones.

Reference: [1](https://www.ibef.org/news/powergrid-fully-commissions-indias-first-vsc-based-hvdc-system) — IBEF2021report.

Examples technology/route સમજાવે છે;exhaustive live asset register નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

FACTSuses controlled power-electronic/static devices to improve ACnetwork controllability and useful transfer.

Explanation and application

  • Shunt:SVCvaries effective susceptance using thyristor-controlled/switched reactors/capacitors;STATCOMuses a VSCto exchange controlled reactive current at a bus.
  • Series:TCSCcontrols effective series capacitive reactance;SSSCinjects a controlled series voltage.Combined:UPFCcoordinates shunt and series converters to influence voltage and power flow within ratings.
  • Benefits:voltage/reactive support,improved damping,flow control and better use of existing corridors;device siting,stability,protection and harmonics require study.
  • A DCcapacitor alone cannot provide indefinite real power.STATCOM/SVCcapability differs at low voltage,but neither device bypasses current/thermal limits or creates energy.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

FACTS controlled power-electronic/static devicesથી ACnetwork controllability/transfer સુધારે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Shunt SVC thyristor reactor-capacitorથી susceptance બદલે.STATCOM VSCથી bus પર reactive I control કરે.
  • Series TCSC effective capacitive X control કરે.SSSC series V inject કરે.UPFC shunt-series convertersથી V/power flow coordinate કરે.
  • V-reactive support,damping,flow control/corridor utilisation સુધરે.Siting,stability,protection/harmonics study જોઈએ.
  • ફક્ત DCcapacitor indefinite real P આપી શકતો નથી.Low-V capability અલગ હોય,પણ device current-thermal limits bypass કે energy create નથી કરતું.

Aim,apparatus and evidence

EHVACin India report

Use current dated official utility/CEA/MoPdocuments and clearly distinguish examples from an exhaustive live inventory.

Connections / study setup

Use current dated official utility/CEA/MoPdocuments and clearly distinguish examples from an exhaustive live inventory.

Ordered procedure

  1. Identify the data/sample/source,ratings,units,scope and authorised supervisor;prepare a labelled diagram and record template.
  2. For any trainer,isolate and verify dead before setup;use approved limited low-voltage supply,guards,protection and rated instruments.Reports/calculations need no live field access.
  3. Use current dated official utility/CEA/MoPdocuments and clearly distinguish examples from an exhaustive live inventory.
  4. Describe nominal voltage,route,function,substations,reactive support,corona/ROWand operational constraints for selected documented systems.
  5. Write only genuine observations/source dates;keep supplied or simulated results labelled and actual unperformed records blank.
  6. Do not call a test installation a nationwide commercial voltage level or mark an announced scheme commissioned without evidence.
  7. Complete the authorised shutdown/discharge and dead verification before rewiring;preserve references,limitations and permitted evidence.

Calculations,interpretation and safe fault-finding

Describe nominal voltage,route,function,substations,reactive support,corona/ROWand operational constraints for selected documented systems.

Do not call a test installation a nationwide commercial voltage level or mark an announced scheme commissioned without evidence.

Precautions

Never approach or climb live lines,switch utility ties,open customer panels or infer safe clearances from these teaching diagrams.Cables/capacitors can retain charge;approved isolation,discharge,earthing and permits are mandatory for authorised work.
